old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-bpyr","title":"DTN: dtn_expire flushes expiry==0 fail-open stores, defeating R-05-080 downstream enforcement","description":"Review finding from b7z9.8.2.2 (passes 2+3). lichen_router_dtn_expire (router.c:1264-1287) drops records when (int32_t)(expiry - now) \u003c= 0; an expiry==0 record is purged even at now==0 (clockless). The R-05-080 fail-open path in lichen_router_route_packet (router.c:700-710) stores wire expiry verbatim, so an S-flagged packet with expiry==0 stored on a clockless node is dead on arrival at the first expire sweep instead of being enforced downstream by nodes with valid time. Fix options: skip expiry==0 records in dtn_expire, or store a sentinel. Must coordinate with b7z9.8.1 (wall-clock fail-open semantics) before choosing.
